Attributable profit US$39,469k / weighted 1,096,556k shares = US$0.036; 0.04 x 1,096,555,900 = US$43.9m vs profit US$39.5m (+11%). Shares and profit are exact; no treasury movement in 2020.

research_notes: Access: www.itmg.co.id (and itmg.co.id) answers every request from this server with an F5 'TSPD' JavaScript challenge / 'Request Rejected' page; idx.co.id answers Cloudflare 403. No challenge was attempted. Every company document was fetched as an Internet Archive raw capture (web.archive.org/web/<ts>id_/<original URL>); KSEI notices were fetched directly from web.ksei.co.id. source_url always carries the original itmg.co.id / ksei.co.id URL; the capture timestamps are in sources.md.

Not retrievable (and therefore null): AR2025 (listed on the IR page as 'ITM_Annual Report_2025_full.pdf' but never archived), the 4Q25 and 1Q26 analyst decks, and the 3M26/6M26 FS (the only 6M26 FS capture is a block page). Consequences: FY2025 ebitda, operating_profit, year_end_price and production are null; FY2025 levels come from the audited FY2025 FS (archived 28 Feb 2026) and the FY2025 news release; the H1-2026 interim comes from the 2Q26 analyst deck, so profit_ytd (attributable), equity_attr, shares_out and fx_usd_idr are null.
Interim period: H1 2026 is the latest published period. ITMG releases 9M results around 11-12 Nov (9M24 on 12 Nov 2024, 9M25 on 11 Nov 2025), so 9M26 was not out on 2026-11-03.

Units: the FS are in USD thousand; all money values here are USD million (/1,000) and were never converted to rupiah. EPS is US$ per share as printed (two decimals). fx_usd_idr is the Bank Indonesia middle rate the FS use at 31 Dec (Note 2).

Per-year sources: FY2019-FY2024 levels are from each year's own audited FS as bound into that year's AR (no restatements found: each FS2025/AR comparative equals the prior-year original for revenue, profit, assets and equity; AR2021 reclassified the 2020 current/non-current split but not the total). FY2019 holds base levels only (no rights/bonus issue, so no FY2019 price is needed).

operating_profit = AR highlight 'Laba usaha/Laba operasi*' (footnote: gross profit less selling and G&A expenses); the FS face has no such subtotal. EBITDA = the analyst-deck figure (company definition quoted in each datum). Both FY2025 values are null rather than computed.

capex = purchases of PP&E + additions of deferred exploration and development expenditures (both investing outflows). ITMG has no 'purchase of mining properties' line; deferred exploration/development is its capitalised mine-development cost. Reviewers who want PP&E only: 2020 19.126, 2021 11.817, 2022 28.397, 2023 53.633, 2024 68.050, 2025 79.002. The AR 'Belanja modal / Capital expenditure' highlight (e.g. 2024 62.4) is a different measure and was not used.

total_debt = bank loans only (short-term + current and non-current long-term). ITMG has no bonds. Lease liabilities are excluded (FY2025 jumped to 50.2 after new equipment leases). The AR 'Total debt to total equity' ratio reproduces our sums (2024 3.6%, 2023 2.7%, 2022 1.3%, 2021 3.0%, 2020 5.1%).

Dividends: ITMG declares in USD and pays in rupiah. Interim = Board resolution out of H1 profit (Sep-Nov); final = AGMS remainder (Mar-May). dps is the rupiah amount from the KSEI notice (for FY2025 final from the follow-up KSEI kurs notice, Rp992); total is the USD amount from the FS dividend note / AGMS resolution. Payout ratios are the AGMS figures (FY2020 90%, FY2021 70%, FY2022-FY2024 65%, FY2025 60%); FY2025's comes from a news report of the 17 Apr 2026 AGMS because the company press release was not retrievable, and is confirmed by the company/KSEI amounts (114.58 / 190.94 = 60.0%). The validator's DPS x shares check does not apply (USD totals vs rupiah DPS).

Treasury shares / buybacks (not schema corporate-action types): 33,369,100 shares bought back in 2016 were held until 2022 and sold through PT CIMB Niaga Sekuritas (plan disclosed 4 Feb 2022; 31,025,500 sold in March and 2,343,600 in April 2022; POJK transfer obligation). A new buyback (max Rp2.49-2.5 tn, up to 10% / 113 m shares, one year) was announced 18 Sep 2025 and approved by the EGMS of 3 Nov 2025; 6,037,900 shares (US$7.8m) were bought by 31 Dec 2025, and the 2Q26 deck says treasury shares were 2.4% of issued shares at 30 Jun 2026. shares_out is net of treasury shares; EPS uses weighted-average shares (FY2025 1,129,677 thousand).

Corporate actions: none since 2019. Each AR (2020-2024) states there was no stock split, reverse split, stock dividend, bonus share or par-value change; the FY2025 FS share-capital note shows the same 1,129,925,000 issued shares at Rp500; a web search found no split/rights announcement in 2025-2026 (management has publicly declined to commit to a split). corporate_actions is therefore an empty list.

Operating datums: production and sales_volume (Mt) are from the AR MD&A text (FY2025 sales from the news release; FY2025 production not printed in any retrievable document). asp (USD/t) is from the AR where it prints a figure (2022, 2023) and otherwise from the Q4 deck / FY2025 news release; FY2024 is 95 in the 4Q24 deck but 96 in the FY2025 news release. ITMG publishes no 'cash cost' figure (its decks show total cost per tonne incl. royalty and D&A), so cash_cost is not stored.
roe/roa (FY2020-FY2024) are the AR2024 'Financial Ratios' values: profit for the year incl. NCI divided by year-end equity / total assets. AR2025 is unavailable, so FY2025 has none.

Ownership: Banpu Minerals (Singapore) Pte. Ltd. 736,071,000 shares = 65.14% of issued shares (Banpu group); public ~34%. Legal name unchanged (PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk, ticker ITMG, brand 'ITM').

Out of scope but noted: KSEI-27194/JKU/1126 (3 Nov 2026) schedules an FY2026 interim dividend (cum 10 Nov, ex 11 Nov, recording 12 Nov, payment 18 Nov 2026), amount 'to be announced'. The FY2019 final (Rp570, paid 22 Jun 2020) is FY2019 profit and is not recorded.
